title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japan Cup. Grass Wonder learns that both she and Maruzensky are predicted to earn places in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The prospect of finally facing the Beast in a decisive showdown looms large in her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the race, Grass Wonder runs into El Condor Pasa. Determined to prove that she is the more worthy successor to the Beast, she accompanies her rival to the track.
